systems.owner: government; INAGE leads the feasibility study with the project unit
systems.tiers: government; no local government office said to be on it
community hubs; connectivity, furniture and ICT equipment under procurement (US$2 million)

note: The mid-term review (26 May to 6 June 2025) reports that the contract for the feasibility study on extending GovNet has been signed, to inform a second phase of investment in the network's performance and reliability. It names no district, municipal or other local government office on the network; its only municipalities are the sites of two bridges in Quelimane. No fact is recorded.
